summary: Single-file PHP monolith with 25+ JSON API endpoints. Critical blockers in authentication (session-only), idempotency (absent), and observability (no structured logging). Positive attributes include well-structured JSON APIs, decision-support scoring, and audit trails.

findings.finding: All 25+ API endpoints return well-structured JSON with consistent patterns
Decision-support endpoints provide scored recommendations suitable for agent consumption
No OpenAPI/Swagger specification — agents cannot self-discover operations
No API versioning
No pagination on list endpoints — unbounded result sets
No webhooks or event-driven notification mechanism
Session/cookie-based auth only — no API key, OAuth 2.0, JWT, or service account for M2M communication
Role-based access control implemented with proper 401/403 enforcement
Passwords hashed with bcrypt
No token scoping or least-privilege mechanism for agents
No audit differentiation between human and agent actions
Fallback credentials in database connection code
No idempotency keys on any mutating endpoint
Order IDs generated with uniqid() — not collision-resistant under concurrent workloads
No optimistic concurrency control (no version fields or ETags)
Database transactions with rollback used for multi-step operations
Well-defined order state machine
Full audit trail in order_status_history table
No state transition validation at API layer
No request deduplication mechanism
Fulfillment workflow is inherently human-in-the-loop — each step requires explicit admin action
Decision-support endpoints present scored recommendations without auto-executing
Returns require manual CS review before processing
No configurable automation boundaries for agent vs human decisions
No approval workflow or escalation path for uncertain decisions
AI Control Panel provides parameter adjustment that could serve as agent guardrails
No spend limits or action rate limits
No structured logging — only PHP error_log()
No correlation IDs or request tracing
No application-level metrics
No alerting on unusual patterns or agent misbehavior
Infrastructure observability exists: VPC Flow Logs, RDS Enhanced Monitoring, WAF metrics
Order status history provides basic application audit trail
No lightweight JSON health check endpoint

critical: Add machine-to-machine authentication (API key or OAuth 2.0 client credentials)
Implement idempotency keys on all mutating endpoints
Add structured logging with correlation IDs
Replace uniqid() with UUIDv4 for collision resistance
Add event notifications (webhooks or event streams)
recommended: Add lightweight JSON health check endpoint
Separate agent audit entries from human audit entries
